gen-dafont-groovy-gf-sulphur-point: Groovy's c nearly seals itself, leaving only a narrow slit, and its loosely tracked lowercase gives the heading a funky, friendly drift. Sulphur Point sans reads openly and steadily, its marker-like line never tiring.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-tiktok-sans: TikTok Sans reads tall and open, its x-height nearly touching the caps. Groovy's loosely tracked, nearly closed letters bring the funk up top, while the sans-serif text below keeps each line crisp and modern.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-ubuntu-sans: Groovy's c nearly pinches shut, leaving just a narrow slit. Groovy is best at friendly, funky attitude, while Ubuntu Sans is best at wide-eyed, pipe-like lowercase that stays open.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-vend-sans: Funky and friendly, Groovy lets its c nearly close while its lowercase drifts apart loosely. Vend Sans then brings a ruler-drawn line and wide, unclosed curve endings to hold the page steady.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin keeps its lowercase tall, nearly reaching the capitals, with curves held open rather than curled shut. And text in this sans-serif moves along smoothly, with Impact Label's heavy letters waiting at the top.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-odia: Impact Label stands commanding and heavy, each letter set alone like a bead on a rod. But the real strength is how Anek Odia's unsealed rounds loosen up all that weight.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil reads round and generous, with big lowercase bowls. Its half-unwrapped c and s keep text flowing easily and modestly, a quiet counterweight to Impact Label's heavy, commanding letters.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-arimo: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label sets each letter apart. Arimo's tall mean line and spacious terminal gaps keep its sans-serif text moving smoothly and comfortably, line after line without fuss.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-armata: Blunt and weighty, Impact Label stamps each letter alone like a bead on a rod, pincer-shaped c included. Armata sans handles spacious, tall-bodied lowercase; the heading handles the shouting.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-atkinson-hype: Heavy hitter up top, each letter standing alone like a bead. Impact Label carries the weight, while Atkinson Hyperlegible's wide-set s terminals keep its sans-serif text moving along without strain.
